terms.gloss: as you please, to your heart’s content
evidence: Lewis & Short s.v. arbitrātus: “freewill, inclination, pleasure” (class.)
terms.comment: The ablative of arbitrātus, one’s own judgement or will: meō arbitrātū, as I like.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 296.
